profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bristol Myers Squibb
profile.summary:
As a passionate software engineer with a strong background in full-stack web development, I am a self-starter and hard worker who is always eager to learn and mentor others. I thrive on coding best practices and enjoy competing in hackerrank programs in my spare time. With extensive experience in the Healthcare industry and National Defense, I am interested in developing data-intensive applications across a variety of industries.

Programming Languages: TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, Python

Front-end: React, Xstate, React-Query, Playwright, Testing Library , CSS/SCSS, Figma

Back-end: SQL, GraphQL, Go, Node.js, Springboot 

Infrastructure: AWS, Google Cloud, Firebase, Kubernetes/Docker, Terraform, Helm, Ansible, CircleCI, Jenkins
